EXERCISE — FICTIONAL

1. Liaison reporting received during the period states that escort tasking was passed to patrol vessels Brenna and Sarn for a movement not yet timed.

2. Entities identified in this reporting: Brenna (P-118), Sarn (P-121), 3rd Naval Auxiliary Group.

3. Partner assesses the reporting as consistent with their own collection but has not stated whether it derives from an independent source.

4. Partner has not released the underlying reporting and has not graded its own source.

5. Partner requested that this reporting not be further disseminated without reference back.

6. Without the underlying reporting this cannot be independently evaluated.
